name: every_starter
caption:
IF OUR WARRIORS CORE FIVE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🐉 Steph = Dragapult: fires from anywhere, 44.7% from three through 8 games
🔥 Yaxel = Charmeleon: still evolving, 21.2 points a night through 10 games
🐴 Podz = Mudsdale: the workhorse, all 82 games last season
📢 Draymond = Exploud: the loudest voice on the floor, 7.8 assists a night through 8 games
🦖 Al Horford = Aerodactyl: 40 years old and still flying, 41.7% from three through 8 games

Who did we get wrong? 👇
